selection: Select representation and C by pooled inner accuracy, then five-class macro-F1, then declared candidate order. Include fold-trained majority fallback. Score only the selected pipeline on outer folds.
scope: Separate locally processed interview-text extension authorized by the user's request to change strategy. Original AV study and frozen reference remain unchanged. No downloads or uploads.
leakage_controls: No label/PHQ/gender/ID fields as inputs. Numeric tokens and rows explicitly mentioning questionnaire scores are removed by fixed label-free rules. TF-IDF vocabulary/IDF, numeric scaler and classifier fit only fitting folds. Speaker identity is unavailable, so documents are whole supplied interview text. Rule filtering does not prove absence of all possible answer/label cues.
limitations: 55% is an internal five-class cross-validation target, not a guarantee. Only 163 official training participants fit/score; all 275 participants and 281 sources are accounted for. Test already used historically; no new validation/test evaluation or reference replacement. No post-hoc search expansion based on outer results.
